international.title: Tories welcome Louise Haigh’s hint government could adopt their plan to scrap Natural England – UK politics live
international.summary: First secretary of state has declined to say whether Natural England will be abolished as part of plans to cut the number of quangos Natural England could be abolished as part of quango cull, says Louise Haigh Q: Can you confirm that, under the SPS deal announced on Friday, MPs won’t be able to vote down any new regulations on food and drink standards? Haigh did not challenge that assertion from the FT’s Lucy Fisher. But she said that, under the deal, the UK would get “a seat at the table” when EU laws were being drawn up. “We will be consulted on every stage of the legislation,” she said. The problem with this lifetime framing is it makes us all wonder when we’re going to die, and compete with each other in the cabinet. I’m going to abide by collective responsibility in that and say it’s a question for the manifesto. Continue reading...
